verdict.rationale: Bench's own pages say smart categorization 'uses your transactions, receipts, and past actions to categorize most transactions automatically.' They also say business patterns 'automatically generate categorization rules,' and an AI Categorization Assistant suggests categories in real time for transactions imported from connected accounts. Together these cover automatic suggestions that adapt to user behavior. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that user corrections specifically feed back into future suggestions (only implied by 'past actions'), detail on how suggestions are reviewed and accepted, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.
